sources.licence: FRED Terms of Use: no scraping or extraction, no storing or caching of FRED content
sources.terms_checked: 2026-11-09: FRED legal page (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/legal/) read again. It says not to do any data mining, scraping or extraction of FRED data, and not to store, cache or archive FRED content or put it in any database. fredgraph.csv answers with no key, but a daily recorder that keeps the values is the use the terms rule out. Not enabled. T5YIE is the 5-year nominal Treasury constant-maturity yield minus the 5-year TIPS constant-maturity yield, so the recorder keeps both Treasury inputs (us-treasury-par-yields and us-treasury-real-yields) and the breakeven is rebuilt from them
sources.attribution: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED
sources.redistribute_raw: no
sources.notice: Not recorded. Rebuilt from US Treasury par and real yields instead.
